SR_POLICY_VALID.desc: Valid SR-Policy configuration with all tables

SR_TE_SEGMENT_LIST_VALID.desc: Valid segment list with IPv6 addresses

SR_TE_SEGMENT_LIST_INVALID_IPV6.desc: Segment list with invalid IPv6 address

SR_TE_SEGMENT_LIST_MISSING_IPV6.desc: Segment list missing required ipv6_address field when segment_type is ipv6-address

SR_POLICY_CANDIDATE_PATH_INVALID_SEGMENT.desc: Candidate path referencing non-existent segment list

SR_POLICY_CANDIDATE_PATH_MISSING_NAME.desc: Candidate path missing required name field

SR_POLICY_MULTIPLE_SEGMENT_LISTS.desc: Valid configuration with multiple segment lists

SR_POLICY_MULTIPLE_CANDIDATE_PATHS.desc: Valid configuration with multiple candidate paths for same policy

SR_POLICY_CANDIDATE_PATH_NO_PARENT_POLIC.desc: Candidate path without parent policy - should fail must validation
eStr: Candidate path must reference an existing SR_POLICY

SR_POLICY_SEGMENT_LIST_NO_PARENT_CP.desc: Segment list association without parent candidate path - should fail must validation
eStr: Segment list association must reference an existing SR_POLICY_CANDIDATE_PATH

SR_POLICY_SEGMENT_LIST_REUSE_SAME_POLICY.desc: Segment list shared by two candidate paths in the same policy - should fail must validation
eStr: A segment list cannot be shared between candidate paths or policies

SR_POLICY_SEGMENT_LIST_REUSE_ACROSS_POLI.desc: Segment list shared by candidate paths in different policies - should fail must validation
eStr: A segment list cannot be shared between candidate paths or policies

SR_POLICY_SEGMENT_LIST_REUSE_WEIGHTED_EC.desc: Segment list from a weighted ECMP candidate path reused by another candidate path - should fail must validation
eStr: A segment list cannot be shared between candidate paths or policies

SR_POLICY_DISTINCT_SEGMENT_LISTS_ACROSS_.desc: Valid configuration with distinct segment lists used by candidate paths in different policies

SR_TE_GLOBAL_SBFD_ENABLE_VALID.desc: Valid global S-BFD enable with profile

SR_POLICY_SBFD_ENABLE_VALID.desc: Valid policy-level S-BFD enable with profile

SR_POLICY_CP_SBFD_ENABLE_VALID.desc: Valid candidate-path level S-BFD enable with profile

SR_TE_SBFD_THREE_LEVEL_VALID.desc: Valid S-BFD configured at all three levels (global, policy, candidate-path)

SR_TE_GLOBAL_SBFD_PROFILE_WRONG_MODE.desc: Global sbfd_profile references a BFD_PROFILE with mode 'bfd' instead of 'sbfd_echo'
eStr: sbfd_profile must reference a BFD_PROFILE configured with mode 'sbfd_echo'

SR_TE_GLOBAL_SBFD_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND.desc: Global sbfd_profile references a BFD_PROFILE name that does not exist
eStr: sbfd_profile must reference a BFD_PROFILE configured with mode 'sbfd_echo'

SR_TE_GLOBAL_SBFD_NONE_INVALID.desc: Global sbfd='none' is rejected - no parent level to inherit from
eStr: sbfd must be 'enable' or 'disable' at the global level

SR_POLICY_PER_FLOW_VALID.desc: Valid per-flow CP: parent type=per-flow plus FC entries referencing two child colors and a default best-effort fallback

SR_POLICY_PER_FLOW_VALID_BEST_EFFORT_ON_.desc: action_best_effort on a numeric FC (fc_key != 0) is valid - every fc_key may forward best-effort, not just the default bucket

SR_POLICY_PER_FLOW_INVALID_BOTH_ACTIONS.desc: Per-flow entry with both next_color and action_best_effort - mutual exclusion must should reject

SR_POLICY_PER_FLOW_INVALID_SELF_REFERENC.desc: Per-flow entry whose next_color matches the parent SR Policy color - rejected (substring matches either the self-reference or child-must-be-leaf must, whichever libyang evaluates first)

SR_POLICY_PER_FLOW_INVALID_PARENT_TYPE.desc: Per-flow entry parented to a CP whose type is 'explicit' rather than 'per-flow' - must should reject
eStr: Per-flow entries are only allowed on candidate paths whose type is 'per-flow'

SR_POLICY_PER_FLOW_INVALID_NO_PARENT_CP.desc: Per-flow entry without a matching parent CP - first must constraint should reject
eStr: Per-flow entry must reference an existing SR_POLICY_CANDIDATE_PATH

SR_POLICY_PER_FLOW_INVALID_CHILD_IS_PER_.desc: Per-flow entry whose next_color points at a child policy that itself has a per-flow CP - chains/loops must constraint should reject
eStr: Child SR Policy referenced by next_color must not itself be 'per-flow'
